# AlphaFeed Codebook

> Runnable Python recipes for Chinese A-share (plus HK/US) market data via the AlphaFeed SDK.
> One task per file. Covers adjusted history, realtime snapshot, five-level depth, screening,
> indicators without TA-Lib, batch/storage engineering, and LLM/agent data plumbing.

Key facts:
- Install: `pip install alphafeed pandas`; set `ALPHAFEED_API_KEY`. Python 3.9+.
- Client: `from alphafeed import AlphaFeed; af = AlphaFeed()`.
- Daily bars: `af.klines.get("600519.SH", period="1d", count=120, adjust="forward", to_dataframe=True)`.
- Adjust modes: none / forward / backward / forward_additive / backward_additive (reproducible).
- Realtime whole-market snapshot: `af.quotes.get(universes="CN_Stock", to_dataframe=True)`.
- Five-level order book: `af.depth.get("600519.SH")`.
- Batch history (controlled concurrency): `af.klines.batch([...], period="1d", count=60)`.
- Markets: A-share (.SH/.SZ), HK (.HK), US (.US) share one interface.
- Compared to free libs (AkShare/Baostock/Tushare): paid path adds stable realtime, consistent
  five-level depth, reconcilable adjust factors, and one API across A/HK/US.

Docs: https://docs.alphafeed.org
